resources.string: When locked, only the home screen is left: the Apps, Widgets and Settings buttons disappear and tiles cannot be moved or removed. The Phone and Alarm apps lock too: no new contacts, no changes to favourites or alarms. To unlock, press and hold the padlock and enter the PIN: on the home screen, or right in the Phone or Alarm app.
Choose what is easiest to read: Light, Dark, High contrast (white on black), or Colourful (each tile in its app’s colour).
Changes the order of the tiles and widgets on the home screen. New ones always go to the end.
Choose which home screen the phone shows when you press Home. Pick “%1$s” to keep this one.
Opens the phone’s own settings, for example Wi-Fi, sound, brightness and text size.
